fields.TEXT: MATTERS NEEDING ATTENTION~1On every boot/reset/wakeup,~1GPIO15 MUST keep LOW, GPIO2 MUST keep HIGH.~1GPIO0 HIGH ->RUN MODE, LOW -> FLASH MODE.~1When you need to use the sleep mode,GPIO16 and RST should be connected,~1and GPIO16 will output LOW to reset the system at the time of wakeup.
